answer: An applicant joins the voting set after lodging a unique basalt measurement enclave with an established registrar and completing fourteen daily settlement audits. Each morning five randomly drawn validators send a nonce; the enclave must echo that nonce plus a signed digest of distinct counterparties it settled in the prior day. Validators recompute the hardware quote and freeze any cluster whose quotes share one factory key. Cheap names fail because the device and a fortnight of real settlements cannot be minted in bulk. Each accepted quote is posted as an opal receipt any peer can re-check.
